description: This Java class represents a downloadable product associated with an order, detailing properties such as product name, download URL, filename, download expiry, and download count.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProductDownload
classes.description: A data entity class for representing downloadable order products with associated properties such as product name, download URL, filename, expiry days, and download count.

methods.name: getDownloadExpiryDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days until download expires.

methods.name: setDownloadExpiryDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days until download expires.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Returns the order ID associated with this download.

methods.name: setOrderId
methods.description: Sets the order ID associated with this download.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename used for the download.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename used for the download.
